about: Community PowerShell tools DE Tech Tool uses. Each entry is pinned to one reviewed commit, with a sha256 for every file DE loads or runs; files come from raw.githubusercontent.com at that commit (or a staged copy) and a mismatch refuses them. 'module' tools are imported (LSUClient, HardeningKitty). 'scripts' entries are proven MSP scripts the Toolbox runs unmodified in their own 64-bit Windows PowerShell process, with the catalog arguments, a timeout and the output kept as evidence; 'confirm' marks scripts that uninstall, restart or repartition. 'reference' repos were read, not used. DE uses these internally and does not redistribute them, so the licence is recorded for the record, not used as a gate. Move a pin with packaging/update-community-catalog.py against reviewed clones, never by hand.

tools.name: LSUClient
tools.usedFor: maint.oem on Lenovo: finds and installs applicable Lenovo drivers, BIOS and firmware straight from Lenovo's update catalog, without Lenovo System Update installed.
tools.reviewNotes: Talks only to download.lenovo.com. BIOS installs report SHUTDOWN / REBOOT_MANDATORY in PendingAction; DE suspends BitLocker first. Install-LSUpdate downloads to %TEMP%\LSUPackages.

tools.name: HardeningKitty
tools.usedFor: baseline.audit-cis: read-only audit against a CIS or Microsoft security baseline finding list; the CSV report goes into the job evidence. DE never runs its HailMary (write) mode.
tools.reviewNotes: Audit mode reads registry, secedit, auditpol and CIM only. Official lists are verified by HardeningKitty against its signed manifest; DE also pins each list by sha256.

tools.name: Win11Debloat
tools.usedFor: Toolbox: removes consumer apps and turns off ads, Bing, Copilot, Recall and widgets for new user profiles (Default profile, -Sysprep). Needs its whole folder, pinned file by file.

scripts.title: Debloat for new user profiles (consumer apps, ads, Bing, Copilot, Recall)
scripts.notes: Best at OOBE or on a fresh device. Removes a curated list of consumer apps for all users (never Teams, OneNote, Sticky Notes, To Do or Quick Assist) and applies the settings to the Default profile so every new user gets them. Exit code is 0 even when a change fails: read the log.

tools.name: Winget-AutoUpdate (WAU)
tools.usedFor: Candidate third-party app update authority for clients without JumpCloud patch management. Not wired: JumpCloud remains the default update authority.

tools.name: winget-install
tools.usedFor: Toolbox: installs or repairs winget, including as SYSTEM and at OOBE (provisioned for all users). DE Tech Tool points to it when winget is missing.

scripts.title: Install or repair winget (works as SYSTEM and at OOBE)
scripts.notes: Downloads winget and its dependencies from GitHub and Microsoft and provisions it for all users. Idempotent; exits 0 when winget is already fine.

tools.name: PSAppDeployToolkit
tools.usedFor: Packaging format for client line-of-business installers that need user prompts or deferrals. Used as its own toolkit inside a package, never merged into DE modules.

tools.name: limehawk rmm-scripts
tools.usedFor: Toolbox: Windows repair, clean-up and previous-MSP removal scripts, run unmodified (no parameters; each checks admin and prints a FINAL STATUS block). Skipped after review: time_sync_fix (hard-codes Eastern time), winre_restore (placeholder URLs), eset_cleanup (crashes on one service; use ESET's uninstaller), winget_setup (asheroto's is better), antivirus_status (SuperOps-only).

scripts.title: Reset Windows Update components
scripts.notes: Stops the update services, renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2, re-registers the update DLLs, resets Winsock. Also deletes Windows Update policy keys: the JumpCloud patch policy re-applies them at its next check-in.

scripts.title: Repair Windows system files (DISM + SFC)
scripts.notes: DISM ScanHealth, RestoreHealth when corruption is found (downloads from Windows Update), then SFC. Can take an hour or more and schedules a restart in 5 minutes when it repaired something.

scripts.title: Repair Microsoft Edge WebView2
scripts.notes: Reinstalls a broken WebView2 runtime (Teams, Outlook and many agents need it). Exits 0 when it was already healthy.

scripts.title: Clear a stuck print queue
scripts.notes: Stops the spooler, deletes queued jobs, starts it again.

scripts.title: Disk clean-up (all drives)
scripts.notes: Runs Disk Clean-up with every category (includes the Recycle Bin), clears the update cache and rebuilds the search index. Stops Windows Installer: never run it while apps are installing.

scripts.title: Disk health (SMART)
scripts.notes: Read-only. Exit 1 means a disk reports Failing; read the Verdict line for warnings.

scripts.title: Remove NinjaOne (previous MSP)
scripts.notes: Uninstalls the NinjaOne agent and Ninja Remote, removes services, folders and its display/printer drivers. Always exits 0: check afterwards that the NinjaRMMAgent service is gone.

scripts.title: Remove legacy antivirus (McAfee, Sophos, AVG, MSE)
scripts.notes: Uses the vendors' removal tools (MCPR, AVG Clear). Loose name matching: review the output. Never on devices where these are the client's chosen product.

scripts.title: Windows LAPS to Entra (Entra-joined devices only)
scripts.notes: Sets Windows LAPS to back up the built-in Administrator password to Entra ID. Not for JumpCloud-only devices (JumpCloud manages local admin passwords there).

tools.name: dszp msp-scripts
tools.usedFor: Toolbox: PowerShell 2.0 removal, N-central agent removal, registry hardening.

scripts.title: Remove PowerShell 2.0 (downgrade-attack path)
scripts.notes: Disables the PowerShell 2.0 optional feature. Exit 1 if it is still enabled; 0 if disabled or absent (Windows 11 24H2 removed it).

scripts.title: N-central agent: show what would be removed
scripts.notes: Preview only: lists the N-able products and folders the removal would touch.

scripts.title: Remove N-central agent (previous MSP)
scripts.notes: Uninstalls anything named "Windows Agent" / "Windows Probe" and deletes ProgramData\N-able Technologies. Run the preview first; check nothing else matches.

scripts.title: Network hardening (SMB signing, NTLMv2 only, LLMNR/NetBIOS off, LSA protection)
scripts.notes: Requires SMB signing, NTLMv2 only, turns off LLMNR, NetBIOS and AutoRun, and sets UEFI-locked LSA protection (RunAsPPL=1, hard to undo). Old NAS boxes and scan-to-folder copiers can stop working. No undo script.

tools.name: flatlinebb MSPscripts
tools.usedFor: No licence: read for ideas only; no code used.

tools.name: PowerShellWarrantyReports
tools.usedFor: Read for warranty source ideas only. Not used: AGPL, and its HP and Lenovo lookups go through a third-party proxy, which would send client serials to someone other than the manufacturer.
